public_rationale: Meta's August 10 disclosure names cleaning, filtering, summarization and ratings, so a literal claim of no preprocessing disclosure is too strong. That summary does not supply the complete procedure Marcus appears to mean in context. The retrieved evidence does not establish the full category-wide claim about raw data and exact recipes. Partial disclosure alone is insufficient to mark the contextual claim contradicted, while the absence of a verified inventory prevents support.
limitations: The primary counterevidence concerns one release.
The archived document describes August 10 but was independently captured later.
General method descriptions are not equivalent to reproducible training code and settings.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Open-weight model releases do not include raw training data, preprocessing methods, or exact training algorithms and parameters.

statement.excerpt: In contrast, when people release open-weight models, they are not revealing the Full Monty. They are not releasing the raw data; they are not revealing how they preprocessed that data; and they are not revealing the exact algorithms and parameters that they used in training.
statement.document_title: Open-source is NOT the same as open-weight

from_speaker: not revealing how they preprocessed that data
not revealing the exact algorithms and parameters
our_interpretation: Assess the ongoing release practice as of August 10, 2026.
Read open-weight contrastively as releases without the complete training pipeline, excluding the fully open examples Marcus explicitly distinguishes.
Raw data means the original training corpus, not a summary of its sources.
Exact algorithms and parameters means the original training procedure and settings, not the trained weights.
The context suggests a missing reproducible recipe. Keep that reading separate from the stronger literal assertion that preprocessing methods are not disclosed at all.
criteria.support_condition: Representative releases omit the raw training corpus and enough original preprocessing and training details to prevent reconstruction of the complete recipe.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Representative in-scope releases provide the claimed missing materials. For the stronger literal reading, substantive published preprocessing methods would contradict the assertion of nondisclosure.
